description: Tutorial lesson T6 (Krumpin'), mouse player path: boot from the tutorial_t6_fight fixture -> End Pile In -> select the Boyz in the fight list -> in the attack dialog pick a melee weapon + the Custodian Guard, Weapon to Target, Fight! -> Fast Roll the dice dock and Done -> end the phase. The attack dialog and allocation overlay are embedded modal Windows, so their controls are driven via the emit escape hatch.

steps.script: TutorialManager.active
TutorialManager.current_step_id()

steps.comment: the SHUFFLE UP! step claims the Boyz are already in contact - no model base anywhere on the board may overlap another (the Custodian Guard used to sit on a 60px pitch, 3px inside each other's 40mm bases)
5 front-rank Boyz + the Warboss are in real base-to-base contact with the Custodian Guard

steps.script:
var b = GameState.create_snapshot()
return RulesEngine.get_eligible_melee_model_indices(b.units["U_BOYZ_T"], b).size()
steps.comment: every Boy can actually swing - two used to sit >2" from the Custodes and could not fight at all

steps.script:
var b = GameState.create_snapshot()
return RulesEngine.get_eligible_melee_model_indices(b.units["U_WARBOSS_T"], b).size()
steps.comment: da boss is in engagement range too
the Warboss token is actually drawn - the fixture used to leave the attached character at UNDEPLOYED, so Main._recreate_unit_visuals() skipped it and da boss was invisible on the board

steps.script: TutorialManager.current_step_id()
TutorialManager.current_step_id()

steps.comment: the instructor card dodges to the left flank here (the attack dialog is an embedded Window that composites above every CanvasLayer) - it must sit ENTIRELY left of the dialog, not half-hidden behind it

steps.script:
var w = tree.root
w.set_meta("t6_scale_probe", w.content_scale_factor)
w.content_scale_factor = 1.4
var d = w.get_node("/root/AttackAssignmentDialog")
DialogUtils._repin_bottom_on_resize(d)
return true
steps.comment: reproduce the reported case: a pad player (PAD_UI_SCALE_BOOST) or a raised UI Scale shrinks the viewport in UI units, so the centred dialog moves LEFT over the card - the re-pin is what popup_at_bottom's own size_changed hook does, i.e. where the dialog would have opened at this scale
still fully clear of the dialog once the canvas is scaled up and the strip narrows

steps.script:
var w = tree.root
w.content_scale_factor = float(w.get_meta("t6_scale_probe", 1.0))
w.remove_meta("t6_scale_probe")
var d = w.get_node("/root/AttackAssignmentDialog")
DialogUtils._repin_bottom_on_resize(d)
return true

steps.comment: the attack dialog is an embedded modal Window - select+emit is the click equivalent for its ItemLists
